purpose: Teach: 下る/改める/件名/にせよ/借家/召集/所蔵/年頃

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究、本気で、結果が、下る、絶対、可能性、考えておけ、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、覚悟、持っておけ、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Ren — take this seriously. Your research might not yield the results you want, but I need you to consider every possibility. Prepare yourself. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Steady, measured authority. Eyes level. Each phrase lands with quiet weight. Not harsh—exacting. The kind of boss who means what he says because he only says it once.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。仮説、本気で、絶対、改めるべきところ、見直してまいります、本気で、感謝、しております、本当に、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. I'll revise my hypothesis thoroughly and review where I need to improve. Thank you so much for your guidance. I understand the weight of this.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. Quiet urgency underneath. Not performing formality—actually present in the moment. Slight lean forward on the gratitude.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文の件名、本気で、絶対、わかりやすくしろ、本気で、査読者、絶対、好印象、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Make your paper's subject line clear. Reviewers form their first impression in seconds. I need them reading with interest from the start. This matters.
lines.style: Firm direction, no negotiation. Lower register. Each instruction lands clean. Pauses slightly between points to let them settle. The authority of someone who has read a hundred papers.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。結果、悪いにせよ、本気で、絶対、誠実に、報告してまいります、本気で、感謝、しております、本当に、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. I'll report the results honestly, whatever they show. The integrity of the work comes first. Thank you for trusting me with this.
lines.style: Quiet resolution. No waver in the voice. Speaks from genuine conviction, not just obedience. The gratitude is real—almost surprised at being trusted this way.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究室、本気で、借家のような状態、絶対、改善していけ、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、これは、絶対、本気で、頼む、絶対、本当に。
lines.en: Your lab space needs to improve. It's looking neglected. This isn't a request—this is something I need you to fix. Make it a place where real work happens.
lines.style: Slightly sharper than before. Not angry, but unmistakable. Leans in on 'lab space.' The tone says he's noticed this particular thing for a while and isn't letting it slide anymore.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会の召集、本気で、絶対、参加させていただきます、本気で、感謝、しております、本当に
lines.en: Yes. I'll absolutely attend the conference. Thank you for the opportunity. I won't waste it.
lines.style: Quick, clean affirmation. Respectful without being stiff. The gratitude is brief but sincere—he means it. Ready to move forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 大学の所蔵資料、本気で、絶対、活用しろ、貴重なもの、絶対、君の研究に、本気で、活かせるからな、絶対、頼んだぞ、本気で。
lines.en: Use the university's archives. Those materials are valuable—genuinely rare. You can build real depth into your research with them. Don't overlook what's already there. I'm asking you to use every tool you have.
lines.style: Shift to mentoring warmth. Less directive, more collaborative. Slower pace on the valuable materials—he wants Ren to hear the actual resource here. Encouraging without being easy.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の同期、本気で、結婚適齢期の年頃、絶対、ですよね、本気で、絶対、応援、しております、本気で、本当に、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yes, and—the lab cohort, they're all at that age where life's shifting in big ways. I'm cheering them on. We all are. Thank you for including me in this department.
lines.style: A beat of quietness at the start. Ren has drifted into something more personal here—he's softening, showing actual care beneath the formality. Warm but still respectful. The 'thank you' is almost shy.
